label: Появиться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for появиться (to appear, show up).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Появлюсь' is the reflexive simple future of появиться, with the в → вл mutation plus the -сь particle. It marks one completed arrival.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Появишься' keeps the -ишься reflexive ending without the labial mutation, which surfaces only in the first person. 'Завтра утром' frames the single event.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Появится' is the reflexive simple future pointing to one moment of appearing. Its imperfective partner появляться describes recurring or gradual appearance.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Появимся' takes the -имся reflexive ending and promises a single arrival. 'Как только сможем' sets the condition.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Появитесь' is the respectful -итесь reflexive future. 'Первыми' is an instrumental marking the order of appearance.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Появился' is the masculine reflexive past with -лся, marking a sudden completed appearance. 'Внезапно' heightens the abruptness.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Появилась' adds the feminine reflexive ending -лась. 'Улыбка' is the subject that came into being in one moment.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Появились' is the plural reflexive past -лись for all genders. 'Новые магазины' is the subject that came into existence.
Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Появиться' stays infinitive after 'обещал'. The perfective marks one planned arrival; imperfective появляться would describe showing up repeatedly.

Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Появись' is the informal reflexive command of появиться, urging one timely arrival. It contrasts with imperfective появляйся for habitual showing up.
